commands.checks: Authenticate frozen live inputs; compile four C++17 enumerators with warnings as errors; independently reconstruct both unrestricted 36,288,252-set coverage histograms and the complete 54,864,810-word restricted domain/table; audit all 251 orbits and 86,900 midpoint triples; check 256 affine normalization controls, predecessor positives, all dirty input columns, behavioral mutations, exact query/add lower bounds and rejection of three timed-out censuses; compare complete RESULT.

native_environment: C++17 compiler required; tested Ubuntu 24.04 with g++ 13.3.0. CXX may name g++/clang++. No native dependency is installed by this package. audit.py alone is portable but does not rebuild the complete census.
